outside_subset_probes.description: NaN list/tuple membership and comparisons, list count/index, and float identity remain outside the admitted subset; all nine probes were rejected.

supplemental_dead_code_probes.description: The exact checker rejects wrong return, assignment, operand and argument types after an earlier return in an unused function.

retained_failed_setup_attempts: Initial normal/ASan logs and results are retained alongside successful retry logs. Writable fixture permissions were restored without changing bytes; 23 affected invocations were retried. No benchmark samples were rerun.
sanitizer_limit: Application LLVM and the custom Imre runtime were instrumented with AddressSanitizer, with leak detection enabled; the prebuilt Rust standard library was not rebuilt with sanitizer instrumentation. The intentional-leak preflight confirms LeakSanitizer activation.
runtime_provenance_limit: The compiler was built from the final clean commit. Previously built runtime archives reconcile to that commit through actual runtime/Cargo/toolchain source hashes; the ordinary archive additionally matches the final workspace output. No claim is made that all archives were freshly rebuilt after the final commit.
